description.en: The region ID of the Mobile node.

description.zh: Mobile节点ID列表。一次请求最多支持100个节点。
description.en: The list of Mobile node IDs. A maximum of 100 nodes are supported per request.

description.zh: Task最大执行步骤数，防止无限循环。范围 30~1000，默认1000。
description.en: The maximum number of execution steps for the task. This prevents infinite loops. Valid values: 30 to 1000. Default value: 1000.

description.zh: 调度计划ID，传入时执行记录关联到对应的定时任务，便于按调度维度聚合查询
description.en: The scheduling plan ID. When specified, execution records are associated with the corresponding scheduled node, which facilitates aggregation query by scheduling dimension.

description.zh: Targets 是一个数组，每个元素是包含 InstanceId 和 SessionId 的对象。
description.en: The array of target objects. Each element contains an InstanceId and a SessionId.
The Mobile node ID, such as acp-xxx.

description.zh: 会话ID，同sessionid的任务共享上下文，如ses-260702-21b****。
description.en: The session ID. Tasks with the same session ID share context, such as ses-260702-21b****.

description.zh: 任务配置ID，用于触发指定配置的任务
description.en: The task configuration ID used to trigger a task with the specified configuration.
The timeout period of the task, in seconds. Valid values: 300 to 3600. Default value: 3600.

description.zh: 用户指令（自然语言），Agent 据此完成操作。
description.en: The user instruction in natural language. The Agent performs operations based on this instruction.
